finding: Backup bundles are unencrypted, not replicated off-server, no automated retention, RPO up to 24h; no real restore rehearsal on an installation
recommendation: Encrypt with age/gpg; off-site copy; retention policy; WAL archiving/PITR; quarterly documented restore drill

finding: No self-service password change endpoint and no forced change at first login; only admin reset exists
recommendation: Add POST /api/auth/change-password, must_change_password flag, revoke other sessions, audit event

finding: Session lifetime is a fixed 12h with no idle timeout; IsValid ignores LastSeenAtUtc
recommendation: 30-min idle timeout, 8-12h absolute cap, revoke-all-sessions, UI warning

finding: No fallback authorization policy; new controllers without [Authorize] would be anonymous
recommendation: FallbackPolicy RequireAuthenticatedUser plus explicit [AllowAnonymous] allowlist and regression test

finding: No vulnerability, secret, SAST or dependency scanning; npm install uses --no-audit
recommendation: Add npm audit, dotnet list package --vulnerable, CodeQL, Dependabot, gitleaks

finding: No React ErrorBoundary; render error blanks the SPA and loses unsaved form state
recommendation: Add ErrorBoundary at app and route level with retry and local-only diagnostics

finding: Single JS chunk 652.72 kB (170.49 kB gzip); Vite warns above 500 kB
recommendation: React.lazy routes and manualChunks; target < 250 kB

finding: lint script is tsc only; no ESLint, react-hooks, jsx-a11y or format check
recommendation: Add ESLint + jsx-a11y + prettier --check to CI

finding: 47 of 107 domain error codes have no ar/fr mapping, so English server text appears in Arabic UI
recommendation: Full code coverage plus automated parity test between C# codes and translation keys

finding: No connection-string MaxPoolSize against PostgreSQL max_connections=100
recommendation: Set Maximum Pool Size explicitly and document the relationship; surface pool state in readiness

finding: Preview middleware re-implements the full API and RBAC in 2,753 lines of TypeScript
recommendation: Replace with static fixtures or isolate; keep parity tests otherwise

finding: No UI component/interaction tests; test glob only covers src/utils; no coverage measurement
recommendation: Broader test glob, Vitest + Testing Library, coverlet/c8 with thresholds

finding: No malware scanning for uploaded PDF/Office files
recommendation: ClamAV scan before persist; keep forced attachment downloads

finding: No documented full-disk encryption requirement despite local PII
evidence: no BitLocker/LUKS guidance in docs or deploy
recommendation: Require BitLocker/LUKS in INSTALLATION and acceptance checklist

finding: 12 dialogs lack focus trap and Escape handling (only project switcher handles Escape)
recommendation: Unified Modal component with focus trap, Escape, focus restore, aria-labelledby

finding: Readiness checks only DB connectivity; no storage, DP key, migration or worker status; no metrics/alerts
recommendation: Extend readiness, structured JSON logs with rotation, alerting hook

finding: Session validation performs 4-5 database queries per API request with no caching
recommendation: Short-lived in-memory cache keyed by user + security stamp, invalidated on change

finding: 132 of 168 tracked PNGs under .tmp-joradp are unreferenced; 13 MB in Git under a temp directory name
recommendation: Move referenced sources to docs/reference-data/sources or external storage; drop the rest

finding: Docs have no automated consistency check; recorded main SHA lags HEAD and test counts are historical
recommendation: Generate status sections from git/CI; label historical numbers with dates

finding: Setup initialize endpoint is outside rate limiting; failed bootstrap attempts are only logged
recommendation: Add setup rate-limit policy and SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_DENIED audit event

finding: No global.json, engines or packageManager; GitHub Actions pinned to major tags
recommendation: Pin SDK, node engine, package manager and action SHAs

finding: No HSTS, no __Host- cookie prefix, CSP lacks object-src, no Kestrel request size/timeout limits
recommendation: Add HSTS in Caddy, __Host- cookies, object-src none, MaxRequestBodySize and RequestTimeouts

finding: EnableRetryOnFailure can re-execute SaveChanges and duplicate audit rows (no idempotency key)
recommendation: Idempotency key or unique constraint for critical audit events

finding: 46 unreachable frontend files (~1,597 LOC) including 19 deprecated re-export stubs in features/
recommendation: Delete legacy tree after updating frontendArchitecture and moduleCatalog tests

finding: Root index.html is a leftover pointing at /apps/local-web/src/main.tsx and is not used by Vite
recommendation: Delete root index.html
